system.description: One could more easily weigh smoke than strike a character who uses this Charm. Until the martial artist's next action, add his Essence to his Dodge DV. The Ebon Shadow Stylist need not even be in combat when he activates this Charm. For instance, he may use the Charm to dodge the poisoned darts of an automatic trap in the tomb of his First Age incarnation. Should the character use this Charm outside combat, all dodge attempts--including those involving Charms whose effects continue from previous actions--gain additional bonus dice equal to her Essence for one action (which can raise the total bonus above the standard maximums). If some internal or external penalty would normally reduce the character's Dodge pool or DV to 0, using this Charm reflexively provides a base value equal to the character's Essence.
